published_note: 200 means the file is served. It is not a reader, and it is not reach.
reach_note: no analytics account. 200 responses, sitemap crawls and relay acceptances are publication evidence, not readers
discovered_note: needs a search engine's own word (Search Console / site: query). A share, a search-engine ping or a sitemap fetch is not discovery, and setting these fields on a share is exactly the mistake this file exists to prevent
traffic_note: no analytics account; human sessions are not measurable here
engagement_note: strangers who replied on an AF issue; null when there is no reply data, never 0 by assumption
